tool_args.rationale: A normalized Hill-2 drive with reciprocal sink inhibition and linear bleed fits all five pilot rows with RMSE below 1e-7. The pilot is already at the requested horizon of 0.7, so submit the law for fresh confirmation without buying another probe.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The pilot already spans 2.0 units of sink gradient, and the four-parameter Hill law fits all five rows to rounding precision.
Its activated drive and square-root branch are not needed to explain the observed onset and sink dependence.
The static law explains the pilot at the requested horizon without adding memory dynamics.
